name: BPC-157
summary: The internet-famous healing peptide — tendon, gut, wound-repair claims. Almost entirely animal data.
note: FDA flagged it for evidence gaps and safety concerns.

name: TB-500
summary: Tissue-repair and cell-migration pathways. Preclinical; product identity varies.

name: KPV
summary: α-MSH-derived anti-inflammatory tripeptide. Preclinical.

name: Thymosin alpha-1
summary: Immune-modulating peptide with real human research — for medical conditions, not looks.

name: Curcumin
summary: Anti-inflammatory polyphenol. Absorption is poor without piperine or special forms.

name: N-Acetylcysteine
summary: Glutathione precursor with established medical uses.

name: Glycine
summary: Collagen's main building block. Cheap, safe, also helps sleep.

name: Taurine
summary: Cell-protective amino acid; thin evidence for appearance outcomes.

name: Boswellia serrata
summary: Botanical studied for inflammation and joint symptoms.

name: Bromelain
summary: Pineapple enzyme studied for swelling and inflammation. Mixed.

name: NMN
summary: NAD+ precursor. The biochemistry is real; visible rejuvenation is unproven.

name: Nicotinamide riboside
summary: NAD+ precursor with human biochemical evidence; longevity unproven.

name: Resveratrol
summary: Polyphenol studied for sirtuin signaling. Human longevity evidence insufficient.

name: Spermidine
summary: Autophagy-linked polyamine. Preliminary human data.

name: Urolithin A
summary: Mitophagy booster with early human trials (muscle endurance).

name: Coenzyme Q10
summary: Electron-transport cofactor. Established physiology; limited cosmetic evidence.

name: Alpha-lipoic acid
summary: Redox cofactor and antioxidant. Thin appearance evidence.

name: Fisetin
summary: Flavonoid senolytic candidate. Preclinical.

name: Quercetin
summary: Antioxidant flavonoid with investigational senolytic effects.

name: Rapamycin
summary: mTOR inhibitor at the center of aging research. Human longevity unproven.

name: Metformin
summary: Diabetes drug with AMPK-related metabolic effects. Longevity unproven.

name: Epitalon
summary: Telomere-hype peptide. No reliable human anti-aging evidence.

name: MOTS-c
summary: Mitochondria-derived peptide studied for metabolic signaling. Preclinical.

name: SS-31
summary: Mitochondria-targeted peptide in disease research. No proven cosmetic anti-aging.

name: GlyNAC
summary: Glycine + NAC combo with small trials on glutathione and aging markers.

name: Alpha-ketoglutarate
summary: Metabolic intermediate investigated in aging biology. Preliminary.
